about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the Worker file of the foundation module contracts joins the workspace package @purin-labs/contracts in packages/contracts, which holds the rest of the module. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package.existing true: the package exists; its manifest gets the export entry and the dependency of this plan and keeps its tsconfig, its scripts and its line in scripts/layers.json. boundary.ts imports @purin-labs/kernel, which is before contracts in foundationOrder. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs, and of a path that is no import; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again.
